question: By what means and in what manner is the practitioner's own body said to be shown, given the cosmic object described in the previous verse?
premises: By constant meditation something is shown.
The object shown is one's own body.
It is shown in many ways.
inference: By constant meditation, one causes one's own body to be shown in many ways.
uncertainties: The relation between the cosmic description of verse 395 and the body shown here is not explicit in this verse alone.
plain_english: By constant meditation he may show his own body in many ways.
